svg.title: Inbound pipeline
svg.desc: A platform event is parsed by one of five adapter paths into a ChannelMessage. It passes the pure ChannelInboundGate, the message deduplicator (Google Chat only; Slack Events deduplicates its envelopes before the gate), ChannelManager (owner, session key, thread binding, pause check) and ChannelTaskBridge (reserved command, rate limit, bound thread) before MessageQueue and dispatchChannelTurn start the agent turn. Refused, duplicate and unowned messages are dropped; a paused message is held and replayed straight onto the queue on resume.

g.text: Hover a box for its invariant or source file; its connections light up. Click it to open its section.
Inside a rendered document this image is static. Click it to open the interactive SVG.

svg.text: Every platform ends in one ChannelMessage, then passes one gate, a dedup check, a pause check and the bridge before the queue.

g.text: PLATFORM ADAPTERS · EACH NORMALIZES ITS PAYLOAD TO ChannelMessage

g.class: e join f-wa f-sg f-gw f-gp f-sl t-gate
e main f-wa f-sg f-gw f-gp f-sl t-gate

g.text: WhatsApp · WhatsAppChannel.handleWebhook parses the GOWA webhook, drops own messages and normalizes
GOWA runs as a subprocess (outpost pattern). Group gating depends on mention_patterns: nothing lands in mentionedJids.
Signal · SignalChannel reads the signal-cli SSE stream (_handleEvent), drops own messages and normalizes
A recipient that is not an E.164 number or UUIDv4 is treated as a group ID, so a group message is matched through its sender.
Google Chat · GoogleChatWebhookHandler verifies the JWT, then gates, deduplicates and hands off
Reply is delivered later through the REST client, not in the webhook response. See the Google Chat ingest figure.
Google Chat · GoogleChatSpaceEventsWiring.processMessage handles CloudEvents pulled from Pub/Sub
Carries un-mentioned space traffic, so its gate runs with mention gating off and a refused message is acked, never nacked.
Slack · SlackChannel dispatches Socket Mode envelopes or signed Events API POSTs
The one adapter that stamps threadId and fills attachments (files it already downloaded).
DM access, then group access, then mention gating
ChannelInboundGate · returns admitted or the stage that dropped the message; it logs nothing and performs no I/O
A missing DmAccessController or MentionGating admits at that stage. Pairing: 3 pending, 8-character codes, 1 hour expiry.
Google Chat paths; Slack Events: before the gate
MessageDeduplicator · bounded insertion-ordered set, capacity 1000, keyed on the Chat message resource name; first seen wins
One instance serves the Chat webhook and Pub/Sub paths. Slack Events checks its own event_id ledger per envelope, before the gate.
paused and not a reserved command? hold it
ChannelManager.handleInboundMessage · the binding lookup runs before the pause check, so a held message keeps the route it would have had
Reserved commands skip the pause check. A message no channel owns is dropped with a warning.
ChannelTaskBridge.tryHandle · channel_task_bridge.dart; stateless coordinator over injected callbacks, so core stays free of runtime types
Rate limiting precedes bound-thread routing so a limited sender cannot bypass the limit by posting in a bound thread.
MessageQueue · message_queue.dart; debounce 1 s per (sessionKey, senderJid), global cap from concurrency.max_parallel_turns
A turn is dispatched once and never re-run; only reply delivery retries. Without a bridge (tests) ChannelManager enqueues here directly.
dispatchChannelTurn · runtime/channel_wiring.dart; gets or creates the session, stages attachments, persists the message
A global-cap refusal waits for capacity and retries only the start, because the inbound message is already persisted.
gate refusal: logged; a new DM
sender may get a pairing code
dropped · gate refusals, duplicates and messages no channel owns stop here
Google Chat and Slack post the pairing code into the conversation; WhatsApp and Signal only record it for confirmation in settings.
consumed · tryHandle returned true: the message never reaches the queue
A non-admin reserved command is refused and audited (guard ReservedCommand, hook channel_command).
cap 200; sender told it is held
PauseController · governance/pause_controller.dart; /resume drains the queue and unpauses atomically
Replay: one collapsed message per (session key, channel, conversation), enqueued on MessageQueue with the session key captured before the pause.
